response.original_title: [passenger@!-FAQs] How do I add a passenger to my MSC Cruise?
response.overview: You cannot add a passenger to an existing MSC Cruise+1-877-619-8065 reservation online—you must call MSC directly at +1-877-619-8065 or ask your travel advisor +1-877-619-8065 to process the change. To add a passenger to an existing MSC cruise, call MSC directly at +1-877-619-8065 (US) +44-289-708-0062 (UK) or contact your travel advisor. You cannot add a new guest to a reservation online or through the MSC app.
